# bitbucket_project (Resource)

A Bitbucket Cloud project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_project" "platform" {
  key         = "PLAT"
  name        = "Platform"
  description = "Repos de plataforma gestionados por IaC"
  is_private  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Project key, uppercase alphanumeric. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `name` (String) Project display name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the project is private. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import/state identifier, formatted as "workspace/key".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_project.platform PLAT
```
